Load libraries
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
```

Load Mtx data
```{r}
x = ReadMtx("~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_counts_normalized_54773x41861.mtx.gz", cells = "~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv/human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv", features = "~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_gene_names_human_41861.tsv.gz", cell.column = 5, feature.column = 1, mtx.transpose = T, skip.cell = 1)
metada = read.csv("~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv/human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv", sep = "\t")
seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = x)
seurat_object@meta.data = cbind(seurat_object@meta.data, metada) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Barcode)
rm(x, metada)
gc()
```

scRNAseq processing
```{r}
seurat_object <- ScaleData(seurat_object)
seurat_object <- FindVariableFeatures(object = seurat_object)
seurat_object <- RunPCA(seurat_object, features = VariableFeatures(object = seurat_object))
ElbowPlot(seurat_object) #determine dimensionality of data
seurat_object = FindNeighbors(seurat_object, dims = 1:20)
seurat_object = FindClusters(seurat_object, resolution = 1)
seurat_object <- RunUMAP(seurat_object, dims = 1:10)
```

Regroup cells in more general clusters
```{r}
seurat_object@meta.data$general = as.character(seurat_object@meta.data$Most.likely.LM22.cell.type)

macrophages = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Macrophages M0", "Macrophages M1", "Macrophages M2"))]
Bcells = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("B cells memory", "B cells naive"))]
dendritic_cells = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Dendritic cells activated", "Dendritic cells resting"))]
mast = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Mast cells activated", "Mast cells resting"))]
nk = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("NK cells activated", "NK cells resting"))]
cd4 = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("T cells CD4 memory activated", "T cells CD4 memory resting", "T cells CD4 naive",
                                                                                            "T cells follicular helper", "T cells regulatory (Tregs)", "T cells CD8"))]
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% macrophages)] = "Macrophages"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% Bcells)] = "B cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% dendritic_cells)] = "Dendritic cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% mast)] = "Mast cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% nk)] = "NK cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% cd4)] = "T cells"

seurat_object@meta.data$general = as.factor(seurat_object@meta.data$general)
Idents(seurat_object) = seurat_object@meta.data$general
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction="umap", label = T, pt.size = 0.5)
```

Subset dendritic cells
```{r}
Idents(seurat_object) = seurat_object@meta.data$general
dendritic = subset(seurat_object, idents = "Dendritic cells", invert = FALSE)
DimPlot(dendritic, reduction = "umap")

dendritic = FindVariableFeatures(dendritic)
dendritic <- ScaleData(dendritic)
dendritic <- RunPCA(dendritic)
ElbowPlot(dendritic) #determine dimensionality of data
dendritic = FindNeighbors(dendritic, dims = 1:20)
dendritic = FindClusters(dendritic, resolution = 0.1)
dendritic <- RunUMAP(dendritic, dims = 1:20)

DimPlot(dendritic, reduction="umap", label = T)

markers = c("XCR1", "CLEC9A", "BATF3", "IRF8", "FCER1A", "CD1C", "IRF4", "CLEC4C", "FSCN1", "CCR7", "LY75", "CCL22", "CD40", "BIRC3", "NFKB2", "IL12B")
VlnPlot(dendritic, features = markers, log = T, ncol = 4, slot = "counts")
```

Differential markers
```{r}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(dendritic, only.pos = TRUE)

markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    ungroup() -> top10

DoHeatmap(dendritic, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend()
```

Pathways activity
```{r}
net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = 'human', top = 500)
# Extract the normalized log-transformed counts
mat <- as.matrix(dendritic@assays$RNA@data)

# Run mlm
acts <- decoupleR::run_mlm(mat = mat, 
                           net = net, 
                           .source = 'source', 
                           .target = 'target',
                           .mor = 'weight', 
                           minsize = 5)

# Extract mlm and store it in pathwaysmlm in data
dendritic[['pathwaysmlm']] <- acts %>%
                         tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', 
                                            names_from = 'condition',
                                            values_from = 'score') %>%
                         tibble::column_to_rownames(var = 'source') %>%
                         Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = dendritic) <- "pathwaysmlm"

# Scale the data
dendritic <- Seurat::ScaleData(dendritic)
dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@data <- dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@scale.data
```

Visualize pathway enrichment
```{r}
p1 <- Seurat::DimPlot(dendritic, 
                      reduction = "umap", 
                      label = TRUE, 
                      pt.size = 0.5) + 
      Seurat::NoLegend() + 
      ggplot2::ggtitle('Cell types')

colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

p2 <- Seurat::FeaturePlot(dendritic, features = c("TGFb")) + 
      ggplot2::scale_colour_gradient2(low = colors[1], mid = 'white', high = colors[2]) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle('TGFb activity')

p <- p1 | p2
p
```

Exploration
```{r}
# Extract activities from object as a long dataframe
df <- t(as.matrix(dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@data)) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cluster = Seurat::Idents(dendritic)) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, 
                          names_to = "source", 
                          values_to = "score") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(cluster, source) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(score))

# Transform to wide matrix
top_acts_mat <- df %>%
                tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'cluster', 
                                   names_from = 'source',
                                   values_from = 'mean') %>%
                tibble::column_to_rownames(var = 'cluster') %>%
                as.matrix()

# Color scale
colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colors = colors)(100)

my_breaks <- c(seq(-1.25, 0, length.out = ceiling(100 / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 1.25, length.out = floor(100 / 2)))

# Plot
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = top_acts_mat,
                   color = colors.use,
                   border_color = "white",
                   breaks = my_breaks,
                   cellwidth = 20,
                   cellheight = 20,
                   treeheight_row = 20,
                   treeheight_col = 20) 
```

Assign DC clusters
```{r}
new.cluster.ids <- c("DC1", "DC2", "DC3", "DC4", "DC5")
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dendritic)
dendritic <- RenameIdents(dendritic, new.cluster.ids)
dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters = as.character(Idents(dendritic))
DimPlot(dendritic, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1) 
```

Rename clusters in original Seurat object
```{r}
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation = as.character(seurat_object@meta.data$Most.likely.LM22.cell.type)

DC1 = rownames(dendritic@meta.data)[which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "DC1")]
DC2 = rownames(dendritic@meta.data)[which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "DC2")]

DC4 = rownames(dendritic@meta.data)[which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "DC4")]
DC5 = rownames(dendritic@meta.data)[which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "DC5")]

seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% DC1)] = "DC1"
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% DC2)] = "DC2"
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% DC3)] = "DC3"
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% DC4)] = "DC4"
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% DC5)] = "DC5"

seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation = as.factor(seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation)
Idents(seurat_object) = seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation
```

Metacells: Setup object
```{r}
library(hdWGCNA)

data <- SetupForWGCNA(
  seurat_object,
  gene_select = "fraction", # the gene selection approach
  fraction = 0.05, # fraction of cells that a gene needs to be expressed in order to be included
  wgcna_name = "MetaCells" # the name of the hdWGCNA experiment
)

rm(seurat_object)
gc()
```


Parallelize
```{r}
library(future)
Idents(data) = data@meta.data$new_annotation
subset_data = list()
contador = 1
cells_labels = unique(data@meta.data$new_annotation)
cells = cells_labels[!cells_labels %in% c("DC1", "DC2", "DC3", "DC4", "DC5")]
for (cell_type in cells) {
  for (patient in unique(data@meta.data$Patient)) {
    x = subset(x = data, subset = Patient == patient, idents = cell_type, return.null = T)
    if(is.null(x) == F){
      subset_data[[contador]] <- x
      contador = contador + 1
    }
  }
}

# Function to process each group
process_group <- function(data) {
  
  if (ncol(data) < 100) {
    message("Skipping group: Less than 50 cells in this subset")
    return(NULL) # Return NULL for groups with insufficient cells
  }
  
  #Create Metacells by Groups celltype_patient
  seurat_obj = MetacellsByGroups(seurat_obj = data,
                    min_cells = 50,
                    group.by = c("new_annotation", "Patient"),
                    reduction = 'pca',
                    k = 15,
                    max_shared = 15,
                    ident.group = 'new_annotation')
  
  meta = GetMetacellObject(seurat_obj)
  list(counts = as.matrix(meta@assays[["RNA"]]@counts), metadata = meta@meta.data)
  
}

# Set up parallelization using the future package
plan(multicore, workers = 4) # Adjust the number of workers based on your system
# Run the function in parallel
results <- future.apply::future_lapply(subset_data, process_group)
results <- results[!sapply(results, is.null)]
reference = data@meta.data[,c("general", "new_annotation")]

rm(data, subset_data)
gc()

# Combine results into a single Seurat object (if needed)
counts_sc = do.call(cbind, lapply(results, '[[', 1))
metadata = do.call(rbind, lapply(results, '[[', 2))

rm(results)
gc()
```

Bind metacells and cells
```{r}
DC_meta = dendritic@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cells_merged = NA,
                new_annotation = .data$DCclusters) %>%
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA, cells_merged, new_annotation, Patient) 

metadata_all = rbind(metadata, DC_meta)
counts_all = cbind(counts_sc, as.matrix(dendritic@assays$RNA@counts))
rm(counts_sc, DC_meta, dendritic, metadata, x)
gc()
```

Add general cell type clusters
```{r}
reference <- reference %>%
  dplyr::distinct(new_annotation, .keep_all = TRUE)

metadata_all <- metadata_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(reference %>% dplyr::select(new_annotation, general), 
                   by = "new_annotation")
```

UMAP metacells
```{r}
library(hdWGCNA)
metacell_obj = CreateSeuratObject(counts_all, meta.data = metadata_all)
metacell_obj <- ScaleData(metacell_obj)
metacell_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = metacell_obj)
metacell_obj <- RunPCA(metacell_obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = metacell_obj))
ElbowPlot(metacell_obj) #determine dimensionality of data
metacell_obj = FindNeighbors(metacell_obj, dims = 1:20)
metacell_obj = FindClusters(metacell_obj, resolution = 1)
metacell_obj <- RunUMAP(metacell_obj, dims = 1:20)

DimPlot(metacell_obj, reduction="umap", label = T, group.by = "new_annotation")
Idents(metacell_obj) = metacell_obj@meta.data$new_annotation
```
